answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vine re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
